h: Late gospel singer ToluwaniSings: her family reportedly stands firm on burial plans as her father appeals to his daughter-in-law
p: The family of the late gospel singer is said to be insisting on its burial arrangements and demanding a full investigation into her death. Her father has reportedly appealed to his daughter-in-law to reconsider burying him at home rather than in a cemetery.
more: The family is reportedly calling for a thorough investigation.
Reactions are pouring in from fans of the singer online.
